remarks: Amazing opportunity to rent in Norwalk. Unit is on 1st Fl. The apartment has been meticulously updated with many fine updates. Convenient to I-95, Merritt Parkway, public transportation, restaurants and shopping. Rent: $2250.00 Security Deposit: $2250.00* See note below Screening Fee: $50 fee per adult occupant. Each adult must fill out their own application. All adult applicants will be screened prior to being placed. Parking: Off Street Parking in drive way (access to drive way is on Davenport St) Laundry: Machines in Basement for Tenant use Tenant Utilities: Electric (power) and Gas (cooking fuel) Pet Policy: Sorry, No Pets Renter's Insurance or Tenant Liability Insurance required.
